description: The line plot illustrates the Overall ROUGE-G Score compared across different numbers of training examples for various models. The x-axis is labeled "# Training Examples" and uses a discrete scale with tick marks at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis is labeled "Overall ROUGE-G Score" and features a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 19.0, with tick marks at intervals of 2.0. The plot contains eight lines representing different models and configurations. An unlabeled solid green line with circle markers (corresponding to a blank grey box in the legend) starts at approximately 16.7 at 0 training examples, increases to 18.4 at 16 examples, and ends at 18.7 at 64 examples. The PELMS (5%) dashed green line with circle markers begins at 16.7 at 0 examples, rises to 17.0 at 16 examples, and reaches 17.9 at 64 examples. The Primera solid red line with square markers starts at 15.0 at 0 examples, increases to 17.2 at 16 examples, and ends at 18.2 at 64 examples. The Primera (5%) dashed red line with square markers starts at 15.0 at 0 examples, dips to 14.6 at 16 examples, and rises to 15.9 at 64 examples. The Pegasus-X solid blue line with upward-pointing triangle markers begins at 13.6 at 0 examples, rises to 15.5 at 16 examples, and ends at 17.9 at 64 examples. The Pegasus-X (5%) dashed blue line with upward-pointing triangle markers starts at 13.6 at 0 examples, declines to a low of 11.6 at 16 examples, and increases to 14.1 at 64 examples. The Centrum solid yellow line with diamond markers starts at 15.8 at 0 examples, increases slightly to 16.0 at 16 examples, and ends at 16.4 at 64 examples. Finally, the Centrum (5%) dashed yellow line with diamond markers begins at 15.8 at 0 examples, rises slightly to 15.9 at 16 examples, and remains steady, ending at 15.9 at 64 examples.
